title_en: Isolated margin: putting one trade in its own box
title_zh: 逐仓：把这笔交易装进独立小盒子
goal_en: Understand per-position margin isolation, and how adding margin can increase the money at risk.
goal_zh: 理解单仓保证金隔离及追加保证金可能扩大风险资金。

shots.visual_en: On the desk: a small box holding 100 and a remaining balance of 900. Sam tapes a divider between them.
shots.visual_zh: 桌上一只100的小盒子和900的剩余余额，小白拿胶带把两者隔开。

lines.en: If I put 100 in isolated, the other 900 can never be touched?
lines.zh: 放一百做逐仓，另外九百就永远碰不到了？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S2 · E21' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第2季 · 第21集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: Isolated margin: putting one trade in its own box
onscreen_text_zh: 逐仓：把这笔交易装进独立小盒子

shots.visual_en: Nexubo keeps the divider but peels off the word 'forever'; the box is labelled with a specific position.
shots.visual_zh: 小纳保留隔板，却把“永远”字样拿走；盒子标具体仓位。

lines.en: Isolated margin means a position gets its own margin. In a simple setup, with no adding and no auto-add, this position's liquidation risk is mainly carried by the margin you assigned.
lines.zh: 逐仓的核心，是给仓位单独分配保证金。在不追加、不启用自动追加等简化条件下，这个仓位的强平风险主要由分配的保证金承担。

shots.visual_en: A loss only lowers the box's equity; the other balance doesn't automatically become this position's margin.
shots.visual_zh: 仓位亏损只降低小盒子的权益；其他示意余额不自动变成该仓位保证金。

lines.en: So it helps you separate the margin of different positions. But that 100 can still be lost. Isolated margin doesn't make losses disappear, and it isn't a stop-loss order.
lines.zh: 所以它便于区分不同仓位的保证金范围。但这一百本身仍可能损失，逐仓不是让亏损消失，也不是止损订单。

shots.visual_en: An 'Auto-add margin' toggle switches on; a pipe carries extra balance into the box; the total money-at-risk number rises. Antenna red with a ding, red chip 'Auto-add moves more money in'.
shots.visual_zh: 自动追加开关打开，一条管道把额外余额送进小盒子；总风险资金数字增加。天线红灯“叮”，红色警示条“自动追加会接入更多资金”。

lines.en: Watch this switch. Some platforms offer auto-add margin. Turn it on, and your available balance can keep flowing into the position. Adding margin by hand does the same. More money ends up carrying the risk.
lines.zh: 注意这个开关：有的平台提供自动追加保证金。打开后，可用余额可能继续流入仓位。手动追加也一样，会让更多资金参与承担风险。

onscreen_text_zh: 自动追加会接入更多资金

shots.visual_en: Sam checks four items: margin mode, auto-add switch, how fees are deducted, total amount committed. Not judging by button colour.
shots.visual_zh: 小白核对模式、追加开关、费用扣取、可投入总额四项，不按按钮颜色判断。

lines.en: Don't see the word 'isolated' and assume the most you can lose is always that first 100. Check the add-margin settings, the fees and the product rules.
lines.zh: 别只看“逐仓”两个字就假定最大损失永远等于最初那一百。具体还要核对追加设置、费用和产品规则。

shots.visual_en: Question card: 'Isolated with auto-add on. Can you still say you'll only ever use the first 100?'
shots.visual_zh: 题目：逐仓开启自动追加，还能说绝对只用最初100吗？

lines.en: With isolated margin, look at the walls, and also at any pipes plugged into the box.
lines.zh: 逐仓看隔离范围，也要看有没有额外接进来的管道。

onscreen_text_zh: 逐仓 + 自动追加 = 只用100？ 不能

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: One position leaks, and another one starts sinking. Next: cross margin.
lines.zh: 一个仓位漏水，另一个也开始下沉。下一集：全仓。

page_cta.line_zh: 在下方保证金风险模拟器里找到自动追加开关，观察风险资金如何变化。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: Find the auto-add margin switch in the practice settings, and explain why it changes the money carrying the risk.
exercise.task_zh: 在模拟设置中找出自动追加开关，并解释它为何改变参与承担风险的资金。
exercise.answer_en: Automatic or manual adding increases the margin committed. You can't promise unconditionally to lose only the initial amount.
exercise.answer_zh: 自动或手动追加会增加投入的保证金；不能无条件承诺只损失初始金额。
